hypothesis: A broad-universe positive-EPS-surprise PEAD paper sleeve (PEAD_BROAD_UNIVERSE_PAPER) will surface independent earnings-drift candidates not captured by the existing POST_EARNINGS_UNDERPRICED_DRIFT_PAPER sleeve. The critical design change: trigger on EPS surprise >= 5% alone, apply gap-cancel (skip if earnings-day gap > 3%), and hold 10 trading days. Remove MA50/RS/pre-event-underpricing/close-location filters that currently restrict the existing sleeve to a narrow 'already-trending' subpopulation. This accumulates forward replacement-value evidence needed to eventually answer whether broad positive-surprise PEAD has meaningful alpha on a wider universe.

evaluation_windows.note: Forward paper accumulation only; no frozen backtest window required for initial sleeve creation. Gate 5 applies before any live activation.

acceptance_rule: observed_only; sleeve runs and persists state daily; at least one forward paper candidate surfaced; design and code are consistent with existing paper sleeve patterns; Gate 5 (30+ closed forward trades, positive net PnL, concentration passed, kill switch) must pass before any live activation experiment

prediction.confidence_reason: Forward paper sleeve creation has high probability of technical success. EV/PnL delta is 0 because this is observe-only paper with no strategy behavior changes. Main known limitation: earnings snapshots only cover the ~45-ticker production universe; true broad-universe PEAD would require separate earnings data expansion, documented in the sleeve.

design_decisions.rationale: Original sketch used 3%. Analysis of 44-ticker earnings snapshot data (Oct 2025 - Feb 2026) showed that large-cap tech stocks in this universe (GOOG, MSFT, AMZN, META, COIN, PLTR) routinely gap 5-10%+ on earnings day. At 3%, roughly 60-70% of qualifying EPS-surprise events (surprise >= 5%) would be filtered out before any forward observation begins, leaving sample accumulation far too thin to reach Gate 5 (30+ closed trades) within a reasonable time window. At 5%, moderate-gap events are retained for observation while the largest-gap cases (gap >= 5%) — where the market has already fully priced the surprise into the open and subsequent PEAD drift is unlikely — are excluded. This threshold is sleeve-local (PEAD_MAX_EARNINGS_DAY_GAP_PCT in pead_broad_universe_paper_sleeve.py) and does not affect the existing POST_EARNINGS_UNDERPRICED_DRIFT_PAPER sleeve or any other strategy.
